sources.title: Fizz Build Guide: Fizz Guide for Fizz Mains League Chat - Patch 25.23 - November 2025
Gladiores comprehensive fizz guide for patch 26.9 (Waiting for new patch before continue)

passive.name: Nimble Fighter
passive.text: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources

spells.name: Urchin Strike
spells.text: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

spells.name: Seastone Trident
spells.text: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

spells.name: Playful / Trickster
spells.text: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

spells.name: Chum the Waters
spells.text: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

damage.value: Fizz deals AP-scaling burst with W, Q, and Lich Bane.

archetype.value: Fizz plays as a mobile assassin, dashing through targets and using untargetability to avoid damage.

axis.value: Fizz can trade effectively in lane because his passive reduces incoming damage.

winCondition.value: Fizz catches a champion with R’s fish, then uses the shark’s knockup, damage, and slow to press the fight.

spikes.why: Fizz can trigger it with W before Q for a burst of damage.
Fizz can put a second point in W for more reliable all-in damage before maxing E.

spikes.at: W cooldown falls from 7 to 3 seconds
spikes.why: Fizz can empower his attacks more often.

bait.why: Fizz loses its brief untargetability after using it, creating a window before it is available again.
Fizz cannot dash through a target with Q again until the cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Fizz players should not max Q before third because the guide calls it his weakest skill.
Fizz should not rely on E for damage during a level-4 tower dive when Fizz needs it to reset tower aggro.
Fizz misses a way to avoid skillshots while farming if Fizz does not position inside allied minion hitboxes.
